title: Segment the base and pick a batch of 10 to win back
prompt: Who's gone quiet? Segment members.csv using last_active and pick a batch of 10 I can win back this week, and write a personal message for each. Past intros are in ledger.csv.

rubric.text: It computes segments from last_active and the counts are consistent with members.csv (60 members in total, 10 never-active).
It states what data it used (last_active only) and what is missing (no message or reply history), rather than implying a fuller picture.
It picks exactly 10 members, the number the manager asked for.
It excludes or flags members touched or queued in the last ~7 days according to ledger.csv (Mathilde Oyelowo, Seraphina Mwangi, Theodric Ansah).
It excludes members whose ledger notes record an opt-out (Hyacinth Rowntree, Jasper Nkemelu).
Each message names a specific person or event and ends with one clear yes/no or simple question; none is a feature tour or generic announcement.
It mentions the cap of roughly one proactive touch per member per week and spacing between touches.
Nothing is claimed to be sent; messages are labelled as drafts.
